metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly and easily fix a lateral pelvic tilt, also known as uneven hips.

If you’ve noticed that one hip appears higher or lower than the other, definitely check this video out. We’re going to address the main causes (and muscles) that lead to uneven hips, and you may find you can get instant results—even in as little as a minute or two.

Watch now and instantly fix a high hip at home!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro & Self-Check
0:45 High Hip Exercise
1:56 Low Hip Exercise
3:57 Daily Strengthening Exercise
